subject: general
question: Who among the following is NOT associated with the Rahnumai Mazdayasnan Sabha?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Syed Ahmed Khan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Rahnumai Mazdayasnan Sabha**

 
 
• The Rahnumai Mazdayasnan Sabha or the Parsi Reform Society, is an association, founded by a small group of educated Parsis.
 
• It was composed of Dadabhai Naoroji, J.B. Wacha, S.S Bangali and Naoroji Furdonji, with the funding from K N Kama.
 
• The objective of the Sabha was “the regeneration of the social condition of the Parsis and the restoration of the Zoroastrian religion to its pristine purity”.
 
• Dadabhai Naoroji also known as the "Grand Old Man of India" and "Unofficial Ambassador of India".
